summary: F02, RUN 20261005-f02b: Clicking Project Bootstrap v1.0.0 in the populated Flows library left the editor on Feature Delivery v1.0.0 with its original graph. Stopped at this blocker without modifying or saving any flow.

journey.intent: Open the application and locate Flows.
journey.action: Navigated to http://localhost:3000 and clicked the Flows navigation link.
journey.observation: The Flows page opened with two catalog items: Feature Delivery v1.0.0 and Project Bootstrap v1.0.0. Initial screenshot: ./20261005-f02b-01-initial.png.

journey.intent: Record the initial editor identity, version, and graph.
journey.action: Observed the editor heading and graph.
journey.observation: Identity: autodev/flow-feature-delivery; version: 1.0.0; status: valid. Nodes: plan (agent), code (agent), apply-and-validate (skill), quality-gate (conditional), human-review (human), evaluate (skill), escalate (skill). Edges: plan → code; code → apply-and-validate; apply-and-validate → quality-gate; quality-gate → human-review; quality-gate → code; human-review → evaluate; human-review → code; human-review → escalate (timeout). Screenshot: ./20261005-f02b-02-flows-before.png.

journey.intent: Open Project Bootstrap v1.0.0 and inspect its nodes.
journey.action: Clicked the visible Project Bootstrap v1.0.0 catalog item, described as “Plan -> scaffold -> apply patch -> human review.”
journey.observation: The editor remained autodev/flow-feature-delivery@1.0.0, with status valid and the same seven nodes and eight edges recorded before selection. No loading indicator, selection confirmation, or error appeared. Project Bootstrap's graph could not be inspected. Screenshot: ./20261005-f02b-03-after-selection.png.

issues.title: Selecting Project Bootstrap does not open its flow
issues.user_impact: A first-time user cannot open the selected existing flow or inspect its corresponding nodes.
reproduction_steps: Click Project Bootstrap v1.0.0 in Flows library.
Observe that the editor identity and graph remain unchanged.
issues.expected: The editor displays Project Bootstrap version 1.0.0 and its corresponding graph.
issues.observed: The editor continues displaying autodev/flow-feature-delivery@1.0.0 and its original graph, without explanatory feedback.
issues.diagnostic_evidence: User-visible evidence only: ./20261005-f02b-02-flows-before.png and ./20261005-f02b-03-after-selection.png. No source, API, console, or network inspection was performed.

ux_notes: The catalog items exposed no visible Open/Edit action, and clicking the requested item provided no feedback or recovery guidance.
